title: A Phase III Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Petrelintide in Participants With Overweight or Obesity
official: A PHASE III, RANDOMIZED, DOUBLE-BLIND, PLACEBO-CONTROLLED, PARALLEL GROUP STUDY TO EVALUATE THE EFFICACY AND SAFETY OF ONCE WEEKLY PETRELINTIDE VS. PLACEBO IN PARTICIPANTS WITH OVERWEIGHT OR OBESITY
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of petrelintide compared with placebo on change in body weight
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Ability and willingness to comply with all aspects of the protocol including completion of all procedures, study visits, questionnaires, assessments for the duration of the study
2. Age ≥18 years at the time of signing Informed Consent Form
3. BMI ≥ 30.0 kg/m2 or BMI ≥ 27.0 kg/m2 and with the presence of at least one weight-related comorbidity
4. Have a history of at least one self-reported unsuccessful dietary effort to lose body weight
5. Agreement to adhere to the contraception requirements
Exclusion criteria:
1. Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) ≥ 48 mmol/mol (6.5%), as measured by the central laboratory at screening
2. Known history of type 1 or type 2 diabetes mellitus
3. Current or previous treatment with petrelintide or any other amylin analog
